name: hover-card
title: Hover card
description: A preview card that opens when the pointer rests on its trigger or the trigger gets keyboard focus.

when: A preview of a person or a record behind a link.

instead.when: A few words about a control.
Content people open on purpose with a click.

guidance.rule: Supplementary only: the trigger must make sense without the card.

builtIn: Opens after a delay on hover or focus, stays while the pointer is on it, closes with Esc.
youProvide: A trigger that is a link (or focusable) to the full page.
